# simplevm_flavors (Data Source)

Lists the VM flavors (sizes) available in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_flavors" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) SimpleVM project ID. Defaults to the provider `project_id`; the effective value is exported.

### Read-Only

- `flavors` (Attributes List) The flavors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flavors))
- `id` (String) Identifier, the project ID.

<a id="nestedatt--flavors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `flavors`

Read-Only:

- `credits_cost_per_hour` (Number) Credits consumed per hour.
- `ephemeral_disk` (Number) Ephemeral disk size in GB.
- `gpu` (Number) Number of GPUs.
- `name` (String) Flavor name.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in MB.
- `root_disk` (Number) Root disk size in GB.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
